## v1.20.10 — Web Console Detection & Enrichment Redesign

### New Features

- **Web console port probe** — Enriching a server now concurrently checks 8 common web panel ports (4200, 8080, 8443, 5000, 9090, 8090, 3000, 25580) with a 3 s HTTP timeout each, all in parallel alongside the existing API lookups. Fingerprints the panel type from the page body: Pterodactyl, McMyAdmin, Crafty Controller, AMP (CubeCoders), Multicraft, PufferPanel, MineOS, or Unknown.
- **`🖥 Web Panel` filter button** — Filters the scanner list to only servers where a web console was detected during enrichment (same style as the existing Vulnerable Only button). Badge also appears inline on enriched rows.
- **Status bar web panel count** — Live count of enriched servers with a detected panel shown in the scanner status bar.

### UI / UX

- **Enrichment card redesign** — The old paragraph dump is replaced with a structured card:
  - 🟢 / 🔴 status pill + server address
  - Stats tiles: Software, Version, Players online/max
  - MOTD block with Minecraft colour codes stripped
  - Plugin chips, orange-highlighted when a known vulnerability matches
  - Vulnerability list with severity badges, description, and patched version
  - Web Console section with panel name, port, XSS context note, and a plain-English explanation of what the detection means

### Project

- README updated with project description.
